explain.say: A computer keeps information in two very different places. RAM is fast working memory that holds whatever you have open right now, while storage, an SSD or hard drive, keeps your files for good.

faq.a: RAM, random access memory, is the computer's fast working memory. It holds the programs and files you are using right now so the CPU can reach them in a few billionths of a second.

faq.q: What is the difference between memory and storage?
faq.a: Memory, or RAM, is fast and temporary and holds what you are working on. Storage, an SSD or hard drive, is slower but much bigger and keeps files even when the power is off.
asks: Tell me about the Storage (SSD or HDD)
Is storage the same as memory?

faq.q: Why does RAM forget everything when the computer turns off?
faq.a: Ordinary RAM stores each bit as a tiny charge in a capacitor, and that charge leaks away within a fraction of a second unless it is constantly refreshed. With no power there is no refreshing, so the data vanishes.

faq.q: Why does more RAM make a computer faster?
faq.a: With more RAM, more programs and files fit in fast memory at once. With too little, the computer keeps swapping data out to slow storage and back, which makes everything wait.
asks: How much RAM do I need?

faq.q: What happens when RAM is full?
faq.a: The operating system moves parts of memory that are not being used to a reserved area of storage, called swap or virtual memory. It works, but storage is far slower, so the computer slows down.

facts: Common DRAM must refresh each memory cell about every 64 milliseconds or the stored charge leaks away.
Reading from RAM takes tens of nanoseconds, while even a fast SSD takes tens of microseconds, about a thousand times longer.

quiz.say: You are writing a story and the power suddenly cuts out. Where were the unsaved changes kept?
quiz.why: Unsaved work lives only in RAM, which loses its contents as soon as the power goes.

wrong.1: An SSD keeps data without power, but only what you have saved to it.
wrong.2: A hard drive keeps saved files without power; the unsaved changes were never written there.
